coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 7 ground-truth variable items (43%): the two baseline prompts, coverage of all 23 BBH tasks, and measurement of per-task accuracy differences. The expected improvement threshold for the latter is not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Substitutes a LLaMA-3-70B transferability study for optimization using PaLM 2-L-IT and text-bison. Omits the 20% optimization/80% testing split, optimization starting from an empty instruction, and final training accuracy comparisons. An empty baseline is not an empty optimization starting point. Replaces the expected >5% gains on 19 or 20 tasks with non-negative differences on at least 16 tasks and positive macro-accuracy confidence bounds.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that optimized instructions outperform baselines by over 5% on most tasks, supporting OPRO's superiority over standard or naive instructions.
